title: Remove deprecated CodeWiki skill surfaces
summary: Cancel accidental aggregate TASK-088 before recreating atomic SPRINT-022 tasks.

goal.outcome: Only codewiki-decision, codewiki-planning, and codewiki-implementation remain discoverable package skills, with router/validation invariants owned by prompt contract and package docs instead of deprecated skill surfaces.
acceptance: Package skill discovery and source-contract tests report exactly the three normal workflow skills: codewiki-decision, codewiki-planning, and codewiki-implementation.
`skills/codewiki/**` and `skills/codewiki-validation/**` no longer remain as package-discoverable skill folders, hidden aliases, or shim skills.
Any bootstrap/router/validation guidance still required by agents is moved to prompt contract, package docs, or non-skill docs with source refs.
Prompt contract describes three loops plus gates, not a four-loop validation workflow.
Package, source-contract, prompt-contract, and prompt-assets smoke tests pass.
No package source imports from `src/validation/**`; all references use `src/gateway/**` or public API contracts.
`src/validation/**` is removed rather than retained as a compatibility shim root.
File-structure docs/diagram/source-contract no longer treat `src/validation/**` as an active package source root except historical refs.
Gateway preflight/report semantics and pass/fail/block output remain unchanged.
Gateway, policy, source-contract, package, and smoke tests pass.
Runtime exposes a fresh-worker request/handoff contract with role, task/build refs, trace_refs, gate_refs, git_refs, and content proof requirements.
Pi adapter bridge uses command-context `ctx.newSession`/`withSession` where available and records platform-limited blockers when unavailable.

Dirty pre-commit implementation validation requires exact working_tree_digest plus patch/worktree handoff evidence; task-close/ship-ready/publication require immutable commit/tree/package/archive/remote proof.
Daemon/agency stop reasons include exact platform/content/remediation diagnostics for unavailable spawn or unsafe dirty transfer.
Runtime/agency/gateway/worktree smoke tests cover spawn-available, spawn-unavailable, dirty-digest handoff, and promotion-proof-required cases.
Graph nodes/edges expose or preserve trace_refs, gate_refs, git_refs, and ArtifactRef-compatible refs for decision/planning/implementation/gate artifacts.
Automation-readiness and agency scheduling cite exact trace/gate/git blockers from graph state.
Legacy build/validation artifacts remain readable through compatibility normalization; no broad historical artifact migration is required.
Graph/status/task lenses remain compact and generated-parity passes.
Targeted graph/readiness/gateway smoke tests pass.

Docs and file-structure map distinguish package source from `.codewiki/**` dogfood truth, generated views, runtime/session scratch, validation/build evidence, `.pi`, `.vscode`, and `.tmp-worktrees` local scratch.
`.tmp-worktrees` remains ignored or is removed only after dirty/claim checks prove safe; no production semantics depend on it.
Post-close GC dry-run identifies eligible tracked/runtime artifacts; any purge writes restore ledger with archive commit/tree proof or records deferral/block reason.
No validation/build evidence required for open/current policy is deleted.
Package/file-structure/generated-parity tests and audits pass.
non_goals: Do not remove public /wiki-bootstrap, /wiki-status, /wiki-config, /wiki-resume, or /linter commands.
Do not implement daemon fresh-worker spawning in this task.
Do not rename gateway concepts back to validation loop terminology.
Do not remove validation report artifacts under `.codewiki/validation/**`; those are dogfood evidence, not package source.
Do not change task-close/ship-ready policy except import/source-root cleanup.
Do not publish or push remote changes.
Do not run broad autonomous refactor work in this task.
Do not bypass independent fresh validation or task-close/ship-ready gates.
Do not migrate every historical `.codewiki/builds` or `.codewiki/validation` file.
Do not change the public gate verdict contract.
Do not remove hot-state artifacts in this task.
Do not rewrite Git history or remove validation evidence needed for recent closes.
verification: git worktree list --porcelain and dirty-state checks
wiki_runtime gc dry-run with archive_sha/tree_sha after close checkpoint
